title: Rain cloud
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cloudGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9d6e8'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#8fa8c8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6d8bb0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- cloud body: overlapping puffs -->
  <g fill='url(#cloudGrad)'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='14'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='34' r='17'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='14'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='48' r='10'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='50' r='10'/>
    <rect x='18' y='44' width='62' height='16' rx='8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- lighter highlight puffs for edge separation -->
  <g fill='#dfe8f4' opacity='0.85'>
    <circle cx='44' cy='28' r='8'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='37' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='63' cy='34' r='6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- darker underside shade -->
  <g fill='#5c7aa0'>
    <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='58' r='10'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='56' r='8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- raindrops -->
  <g fill='#4fc3f7' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='1'>
    <path d='M28 68 q3 6 0 9 q-3 -3 0 -9 z'/>
    <path d='M42 72 q3 6 0 9 q-3 -3 0 -9 z'/>
    <path d='M56 68 q3 6 0 9 q-3 -3 0 -9 z'/>
    <path d='M70 72 q3 6 0 9 q-3 -3 0 -9 z'/>
    <path d='M35 82 q2.5 5 0 7.5 q-2.5 -2.5 0 -7.5 z'/>
    <path d='M63 82 q2.5 5 0 7.5 q-2.5 -2.5 0 -7.5 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
